app.name: FITD Wii Teste 06
app.short_description: Wii GX original room-space actor, automatic camera and mask test
app.long_description: Preliminary PowerPC/GX homebrew technical prototype for the classic Alone in the Dark engine. AITD1 original BODY actor in ETAGE room coordinates, game camera perspective, automatic mask tests, room collisions. Diagnostic prototype, NOT playable game. NOT a playable game. Original game files are not included.
